name: Senso-ji Temple
description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, in Asakusa, approached through the iconic Kaminarimon Gate and a lively shopping street lined with traditional snacks and souvenirs.

name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
description: A tranquil Shinto shrine set within a forested park near Harajuku, dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken — a peaceful contrast to the surrounding city.

name: Shibuya Crossing
description: The world's busiest pedestrian scramble crossing, best experienced at street level or viewed from above at the Starbucks or Shibuya Sky observation deck.

name: Tokyo Tower
description: A red-and-white communications tower inspired by the Eiffel Tower, with observation decks offering panoramic views across the city.

name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
description: A large landscaped park blending Japanese, French, and English garden styles — especially popular during cherry blossom season in spring.
